title: lithocardium calocephalum
intro: Lithocardium calocephalum, commonly known as Lithocarpus calocephalus, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Fagaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Lithocardium calocephalum include acting as a vasodilator, which can help to lower blood pressure, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
